scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Fellowship
other_conditions: Must be a 1st rank holder in a recognized university/post‑graduate level examination in basic or applied sciences (including engineering, pharmacy, agricultural, veterinary) or in medicine conducted by an Indian university/institution
The programme in which the rank was obtained must have a batch size of at least 07 students
Minimum aggregate of 70 % marks (or equivalent CGPA) in the entire course/program is required
INSPIRE scholars with at least 70 % marks (or equivalent CGPA) in M.Sc./Integrated M.S./M.Sc. are also eligible
Fellowship is only for pursuing a full‑time Ph.D. programme in any recognized university/institution/R&D laboratory in India
Fellow must keep DST updated on research progress and may not take any paid or unpaid assignment unrelated to the approved research programme
The fellow must complete the research work and submit the Ph.D. thesis, publications and any patents within the 5‑year tenure of the fellowship
The fellow must acknowledge DST support in all publications, patents and the Ph.D. thesis
benefits_summary: Provides a fellowship of up to five years for a full‑time Ph.D., including HRA as per GoI norms and a contingency grant of up to ₹20,000 per annum.
